product.name: Regular Fit Ripstop Cargo Pants
product.description: Regular-fit cargo pants in woven, hard-wearing ripstop fabric. Drawstring and covered elastic at waistband and zip fly with button. Side pockets, back pockets, and leg pockets, all with flap and concealed snap fasteners. Covered elastic at hems.
